# Nursing in Practice

> > Nursing in Practice is the UK's leading resource for primary care nursing news, clinical education, and professional development.

Nursing in Practice provides comprehensive coverage of nursing practice across primary care, general practice, and community nursing settings. The site combines clinical case studies and guidance with news, professional development resources, and expert interviews covering respiratory care, women's health, cardiovascular health, and other key clinical areas.

## Key Topics

- Primary care nursing
- General practice nursing
- Community nursing
- Respiratory health
- Women's health
- Clinical articles
- Professional development
- Staff support
- NMC registration
- NHS health
- Patient safety
- Palliative care
- Vaccination
- Endometriosis
- Asthma

## Clinical Practice & Case Studies

- [Case by case - diagnosing asthma in adults](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/clinical-features/case-by-case-diagnosing-asthma-in-adults): Clinical case study on adult asthma diagnosis by respiratory specialist Maria Eurton
- [Practice dilemma: How can I support a patient refusing to take their hypertension medication?](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/cardiovascular/practice-dilemma-how-can-i-support-a-patient-refusing-to-take-their-hypertension-medication): Clinical guidance on managing patient medication non-adherence in hypertension
- [Interview: respiratory care needs a holistic and team-based approach](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/respiratory/interview-respiratory-care-needs-a-holistic-and-team-based-approach): Interview with Asthma + Lung UK clinical lead on respiratory care approaches
- [Interview: closing the nine-year gap in endometriosis diagnosis](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/womens-health/interview-closing-the-nine-year-gap-in-endometriosis-diagnosis): Interview on addressing diagnostic delays in endometriosis in primary care
- [Nursing in Practice virtual returns with a day focused on respiratory and women's health](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/womens-health/nursing-in-practice-virtual-returns-with-a-day-focused-on-respiratory-and-womens-health): Announcement of virtual CPD event on respiratory and women's health nursing

## Nursing News & Policy

- [Redeployed nurses 'disempowered' and with 'little support', finds Covid inquiry](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/latest-news/redeployed-nurses-disempowered-and-with-little-support-finds-covid-inquiry): News article on Covid-19 inquiry findings on nurse redeployment challenges
- [Lack of 'primary care-specific' support for staff during Covid](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/latest-news/lack-of-primary-care-specific-support-for-staff-during-covid): News article on lack of Covid-19 support for primary care nursing staff
- [NMC budget and registration fees to be discussed in next council meet](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/latest-news/nmc-budget-and-registration-fees-to-be-discussed-in-next-council-meet): News article on NMC budget and registration fee discussions
- ['Too many patients' receiving palliative care in hospitals instead of hospices](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/latest-news/too-many-patients-receiving-palliative-care-in-hospitals-instead-of-hospices): News article on palliative care provision and hospice funding challenges
- [Up to 5,000 Kent students to be offered meningitis vaccine with potential for expansion](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/clinical/vaccination-and-infection/up-to-5000-kent-students-to-be-offered-meningitis-vaccine-with-potential-for-expansion): News on meningitis vaccination campaign for Kent university students
- ['Unique' apprenticeship approved for nursing associates to qualify in 16 months](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/professional/training/unique-apprenticeship-approved-for-nursing-associates-to-qualify-in-16-months): News on accelerated nursing associate degree approved by NMC

## Professional Views & Analysis

- [Embedding compassionate leadership in general practice nursing](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/views/embedding-compassionate-leadership-in-general-practice-nursing): Opinion piece on compassionate leadership strategies in general practice nursing
- [What happens after violence and abuse from patients?](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/views/what-happens-after-violence-and-abuse-from-patients): Opinion on responding to patient violence and abuse in nursing practice
- [GPNs can't afford to keep being left out – have your say on pay today](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/views/gpns-cant-afford-to-keep-being-left-out-have-your-say-on-pay-today): Opinion on general practice nurse pay negotiations and advocacy
- ['People don't realise the high skills primary care nurses have'](https://www.nursinginpractice.com/analysis/how-nurses-count/people-dont-realise-the-high-skills-primary-care-nurses-have): Analysis on primary care nurse skills recognition and policy advocacy
